summary: Describes QNAME minimisation, a technique that improves DNS privacy. Instead of always sending the full query name and type to every upstream server, a resolver sends only as much as each server needs to see. This limits what the servers high in the DNS hierarchy learn about users. It obsoletes RFC 7816.

eli5.summary: Asking for directions, you only tell each helper the part they need, not your whole trip.
